I replied to Sofia in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics is with Kwame Adjei-Rowe, so the ticket should go to him.

That comes from Bettina's correction on Oct 14, which said Pellucid stays with Kwame. Her first note, that it was coming back to her, was a mix-up with Pellow.

If the ticket is really for Pellow Home Living, Bettina is covering it while Sofia is at Hagerstown. I told Sofia how to tell them apart: Gulf Coast terminal rows are Pellucid, and Mid-Atlantic home goods rows are Pellow.

I couldn't find any account files to check this against, so it rests on what was said in the channel.
